summary: Iteration 6 fully verified end-to-end: backend 7/7 pytest PASS and frontend playwright PASS on real mobile viewport (390x844). (A) Version 3.0 bump — manifest.json name='Tus2 by Mimo 3.0', description contains 'Version 3.0', manifest.id STILL == 'Mimos App' (installed v2 PWAs will receive this as an update, not a fresh install); sw.js SW_VERSION="3.0.0" & cache 'tus2-mimo-3.0.0'; package.json version=='3.0.0'; app.json expo.version=='3.0.0'; Login screen renders exactly one 'Version 3.0' pill. (B) EventCard rendering: AWAY Spiel event has BOTH testID='fahre-{id}' and testID='bier-{id}' inside the same event-card, laid out side-by-side (measured bounding boxes: fahre x=33 y=704.5 w=158 h=40, bier x=199 y=704.5 w=158 h=40 — identical Y, different X, height==40 matching styles.extraBtnSmall). HOME Spiel event has NEITHER testID rendered. Training has only testID='bier-{id}' (no fahre) at full width. (C) Beer end-to-end for Spiel: POST /api/beer with beer:true returns {ok:true}; GET /api/attendance contains the row with beer==true; a team chat message is auto-inserted containing '🍺' AND 'Spiel' (verified NOT to contain 'Training' — proves the type-branching text works). Toggle off inserts a message with '🍺❌' AND 'Spiel'. (D) Regressions: maps-{away_id} route button still present on away Spiel; /api/files/{fid}/thumbnail returns 200 image/*; POST /api/events/{id}/cancel still hard-deletes ({ok:true, deleted:true}); GET /api/unread scan runs without error. No red screens, no new console errors introduced (only the pre-existing 'shadow*' & 'expo-notifications web' warnings carry over).
